page.notes: The heading line is printed in italic and is a reference, not a running head. The Hebrew is printed with vowel points; the points above are my best reading and may not match the scan exactly. Latin glosses are printed in the reverse of Hebrew word order, read left to right by row, as they stand. The transliterations contain printed accents and diacritics (ú, à, è, ì, ṯ) that may be imperfectly rendered; a few sub-letters in the second and fifth rows are uncertain, notably "ìbcrèd-.---lo" in row six, which I could not read with confidence and should be checked against the scan.
